nodes.description: 1024x1024 app icon for the socialio/КонтентГров SMM platform. Deep green rounded-square background (#15795A, rx=180). White stroke paths inside: two concentric arc/wave curves (resembling Wi-Fi or broadcast signal waves) plus an upward-pointing chevron/arrow above them, suggesting content distribution or social broadcasting. Clean, minimal icon suitable for Meta App Review submission.
